title: AS2 compiler: array literals [a,b,c] cause stack underflow
description: Array literals in expressions like display_mc.filters = [f1, f2] cause AVM1 stack underflow. ActionInitArray (0x42) must push elements in reverse order then count last; current code pushes count first causing Ruffle to pop the count as element[0]. Same bug in compileObjectLiteral. Verified by evaporatingdrip.fla Avm1::pop: Stack underflow warnings.
